summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine long-term supplier partnership with Hyundai WIA for the design and manufacture of landing gear for its Valo eVTOL aircraft. The filing includes a press release and forward-looking statements about certification and commercialization. No transaction involving securities, change of control, or special situation is present. This is an ordinary business development and supply agreement disclosure, not a special-situation event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report on a commercial relationship.
